Question B-005-007-005.

Why the correct answer is right: Wavelength is the physical distance occupied by one complete cycle of a wave as it travels. It is usually represented by the Greek letter lambda.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Wave speed": Wave speed is distance per unit time, not distance per cycle.
- sourceIndex 2: "Waveform": Waveform describes the shape of the signal, such as sinusoidal or square, not the length of one cycle.
- sourceIndex 3: "Wave spread": Wave spread is not the standard term for the distance covered by one complete AC cycle.
